title: Fraïssé's conjecture, partial impredicativity and well-ordering principles, part II
summary: We exhibit a well-ordering principle that is equivalent to a theory of partial impredicativity. The latter goes back to Towsner and relates to recent work of Suzuki and Yokoyama. Together with part I of the present paper, this yields a combinatorial upper bound on the axiomatic strength of Fraïssé's conjecture.
